description: This PHP class calculates the required ad impressions for campaigns with inventory requirements and expiration dates, used in ad server campaign management.

classes.name: OA_Maintenance_Priority_AdServer_Task_GetRequiredAdImpressionsLifetime
classes.description: A class to calculate the number of required ad impressions for campaigns with inventory requirements and expiration dates, extending the base impression calculation class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and sets the type to indicate campaign lifetime and end date considerations.

methods.name: _getValidCampaigns
methods.description: Retrieves campaigns that are active, not expired, and have inventory requirements, based on current date and campaign status.

methods.name: getCampaignImpressionInventoryRequirement
methods.description: Estimates the impressions needed for a campaign to meet its lifetime requirements, calling the parent method.
